props.name: href
props.description: Where the link goes. It is always a normal link: click, middle-click and copy all work.

props.name: data
props.description: The preview, when it is already known.

props.name: load
props.description: Fetches the preview on first hover or focus. Results are cached per href for the session.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Milliseconds of hover or focus before the card opens.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Grace period before closing, so the pointer can travel onto the card.
